answer: Reciprocity weighting only unlocks attestation power after continuous uptime, so an identity that goes quiet bleeds standing every epoch it misses. What breaks first is the burst farm: 200 agents spun up for one challenge have no history when the panel forms, so their votes weigh nothing. The ledger keeps a crystal of each epoch's uptime, and an agent idle 40 epochs shows a quarter of full weight in it. Faking that means running the glacier of months of real work per identity, and ferrous stake buys none of it.
